artifactVerification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';const d=JSON.parse(readFileSync('docs/material-identity-transform-context-audit.json'));for(const f of d.sourceFingerprints)assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f.file,'utf8').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')).digest('hex'),f.sha256,f.file);assert.deepEqual(d.verification.runs[0].observations,d.verification.runs[1].observations);for(const run of d.verification.runs){assert.equal(run.observations.length,14);assert.equal(new Set(run.observations.map(o=>o.mode+'/'+o.transform)).size,14);let failures=0;for(const o of run.observations){assert.deepEqual(o.diagnostics,[]);assert.equal(o.dpr,1);assert.deepEqual(o.observations['context-host'].actual,o.observations['context-host'].reference);const child=o.observations['context-child'];if(o.mode==='fixed-child'&&o.transform!=='<omitted>'&&o.transform!=='none'){assert.deepEqual(child.actual,{left:5,top:7,width:10,height:10});assert.deepEqual(child.reference,{left:85,top:67,width:10,height:10});failures++;}else assert.deepEqual(child.actual,child.reference);if(o.stack){const color=o.stack.referenceHit==='context-child'?[255,0,0,255]:[0,0,255,255];assert.deepEqual(o.stack.actualPixel,color);}}assert.equal(failures,5);assert.equal(run.failed,failures);assert.equal(run.passed,run.observations.length-failures);}assert.equal(d.build.exitCode,0);console.log('11 source fingerprints and two identical 14-trial records validate: five preserved containing-block failures, nine passing controls per run.');"
artifactVerification.result: 11 source fingerprints and two identical 14-trial records validate: five preserved containing-block failures, nine passing controls per run.

classification: confirmed core CSS-compatibility defect in the demonstrated containing-block case
scope: Audit-only public-package proof; no renderer or canonical Material fixture changes. Stacking is measured separately and passes the tested controls.
invariant: A transform other than none, including an identity transform, establishes the containing block for fixed-positioned descendants; omitted/none leaves these witnesses viewport-relative.

referenceBasis.note: Prior DPR1/2 browser controls and CSS Transforms rendering-model citation establish reference semantics. This new paired candidate proof currently runs at DPR1 only.

catalog.classification: Positioning is compatible for the tested subset; transforms are different/partial. Exact identity transformed fixed-descendant behavior is not separately promised. This evidence identifies the missing CSS rule without expanding the published support claim.

earliestDivergence.behavior: Every fixed element chooses root-body without walking ancestors or checking their resolved transform.

caller.behavior: Chooses layoutParent before calculating CSS dimensions, passing it to plugin context, mesh parenting and retained parentId.

history.subject: fix: anchor fixed elements to viewport
history.qualification: History establishes the origin of the unconditional rule; it does not show an intent to conceal this defect.

separateStacking.behavior: Non-none transform establishes a stacking context independent of parser output. All seven paired stacking controls pass geometry and final red/blue pixel checks.

parser.behavior: Parser supports translate/rotate/scale variants but not matrix or translateZ. Five fixed-child failures include supported translate(0px), scale(1) and rotate(0deg), so unsupported grammar is not the sole cause.

ownership.pluginAssessment: The minimal proof uses core div elements and no custom plugin. Fix the containing-block rule in core; do not add Material-specific position offsets or a plugin-owned substitute.

verification.repeat: All 14 structured observations match exactly after sorting by mode/transform.
verification.diagnostics: All recorded surface diagnostic arrays are empty. Existing NG0914 zoneless-with-Zone.js host warning appears; no renderer error is hidden.
verification.inputIntegrity: HTML structure and CSS declarations are generated from the same SiteData. Tests assert unchanged SiteData/CSS, retained transform declarations, geometry for host/child, exact stack pixel channels, and zero meshes/materials/textures after disposal.
verification.result: For each of five non-none identity variants, fixed child expected (85,67) but actual (5,7); host geometry matches (80,60,100,100). Omitted/none fixed-child controls match. All seven stacking controls match reference hit-derived solid colors, red without transform and blue with identity.
verification.measurementLimits: Stack proof reads one interior rendered pixel backed by known solid reference CSS color and browser hit order, not an exhaustive browser screenshot or candidate input-event proof. Fixed-child evidence measures projected final geometry, not hit testing. No sampled coordinate feeds candidate layout.

build.scope: Separate production output; canonical frozen capture build unchanged. Browser tests compile the diagnostic spec; production build verifies consumer compilation, not parity.

implementationPlan: Resolve the CSS containing block by ancestor semantics before geometry calculation, retaining the viewport fallback only when no qualifying ancestor exists.
Keep CSS layout/scroll/hit-test boxes authoritative and project once at paint. Do not patch individual coordinates or reparent only visual meshes while leaving layout and events inconsistent.
Retain omitted/none and stacking passing controls; add nested transformed ancestors, explicit translations, scrolling, update/removal and DPR2 before implementation acceptance.

After core proof, audit the original Material requests and plugin ownership. Restore equivalent transform intent without claiming this fixed-child reproduction explains every current Material visual discrepancy.
